subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

judge.implied_focus: The nature/characteristics of incidents themselves -- what the incident is about (issue type, severity, scope, recurrence) as the analyzable focus

per_column.name: primary_issue_category
per_column.rationale: Directly characterizes what the incident is about; a core facet of the incident-nature focus and data-inferable from short_description.

per_column.name: issue_severity_signal
per_column.rationale: A distinct facet describing failure type/severity of the incident, complementing category.

per_column.name: location_or_scope
per_column.rationale: Describes the blast radius/scope of the incident, another coherent facet of incident nature.

per_column.name: issue_recurrence_pattern
per_column.rationale: Captures whether the incident is systemic/recurring vs isolated -- a strong actionable facet of the incident focus.

per_column.name: assigned_technician
per_column.rationale: Largely a normalized restatement of existing assigned_to; centers on handler rather than incident nature, pulling toward a different (workload/ownership) focus.

per_column.name: same_person_assigned_closed
per_column.rationale: A process/workflow flag derivable from existing assigned_to/closed_by; belongs to a handling-process focus, not the incident-nature focus the other columns build.

judge.rationale: Four of six columns (category, severity, scope, recurrence) coherently center on a single inferable focus -- the nature and characteristics of the incidents -- forming a genuine multi-facet analytical structure at useful granularity, all derivable from short_description. This focus is highly actionable (points analysts toward systemic issues, hotspots, severity distributions). However, assigned_technician is essentially a restatement of the existing assigned_to column, and same_person_assigned_closed is a process metric derivable from existing fields; both drift toward a separate handling/workflow focus, diluting single-concept coherence and adding some grab-bag character. The dominant facet cluster is strong, but the two off-focus columns prevent a top score on coherence.
